title: Chapter 38: Counter-Encirclement And Suppression (Part 2)
content:
Chapter 38: Counter-Encirclement And Suppression (Part 2)

The Zerg army rushed towards another Lizardman army without bothering to clean up the battlefield.

The Zerglings were fast. They did not wait for the Hydralisks, but sped up, entered the new battlefield position in advance, and hid underground.

The Hydralisks controlled the marching speed and controlled the meeting point between them and the Lizardman army at the predetermined battlefield position.

At the moment when the signal flare was fired in the first battle, Wu Qing ordered the scouting Zerglings to completely clear the bear goblin scouts in this area.

One in the light and the other in the dark, the Zerglings can quickly gather superior forces to surround and kill the bear goblin scouts.

Clearing the enemy's scouts is equivalent to blinding the enemy's eyes, and the Zerg can freely move around in this area.

In the process of clearing the scouts, some scouts also fired small signal flares for mutual communication. These signal flares did not play any role except attracting other scouts to die.

Under the intentional control of the Zerg Hydralisks, they just ran into a fast-moving Lizardman army head-on.

A premeditated encounter began.

Facing the long-range attack of 400 hydralisks, the Lizardmen army first threw stones to counterattack, and after finding that the long-range attack was not effective, they began to attack the entire army and wanted to fight in close combat.

In this battle, because the hydralisks were not ambushed in advance and did not occupy a favorable long-range attack position, they could only attack the front of the Lizardmen army, and the killing efficiency was incomparable to the first ambush.

But even so, the speed at which the hydralisks caused damage was still too fast in the eyes of the knight in charge of the Lizardmen army.

He hesitated for a moment, but still sounded the signal flare, sending out the signal of encountering a strong enemy again.

Both locations encountered strong enemies, and how to deal with them would test the wisdom of the person commanding this encirclement and suppression war.

The last Lizardmen army outside was not affected by the signal flare. Their strength was limited, so they still rushed to the first battlefield according to the predetermined plan.

In the city of the bear goblins, three armies had already left the city and were marching quickly to the first battlefield.

These three armies, each with a size of 5,000 people, two are lizardmen, and the other is an elite force of bear goblins.

The total size of the army, including 5,000 elite bear goblins, in the eyes of the bear goblins, such an army, in this area, except for the main force of the Tengu people, can crush the army of other territories.

When the second signal flare was launched, the bear goblin city sent a scout team of nearly 100 people to conduct reconnaissance. The three reinforcements of the encirclement and suppression troops did not change their goals and went straight to the first battlefield.

This is a typical information gap and time difference!

The bear goblins did not expect that the Zerg’s ability to control the battlefield situation is so strong, its combat power is so strong, and its ability to act is so strong.

The Zerg is a group creature. The entire Zerg can be regarded as a whole, with one heart and a network of minds. Many of their abilities are beyond the imagination of ordinary people.

If it were an ordinary army, Wu Qing would never dare to fight such a war. Only the Zerg can create such a miracle.

On the second battlefield, when they found that long-range attacks had no effect on the Hydralisks, the Lizardmen launched a desperate charge.

Because the Hydralisks' attack surface became narrower, the Lizardmen's attack intensity per unit area increased greatly, and the Lizardmen soldiers charging in the front could not rush two steps before they fell down.

The Lizardmen behind continued to step on their companions' bodies and rush forward!

Fortunately, the dead Lizardmen would disappear in light, otherwise it would be hard to say whether this Lizardmen army could continue to charge.

Of course, without the obstruction of the Lizardmen's corpses, the Hydralisks' attacks were smoother and more effective.

According to this style of play, as long as the Hydralisks move a little, using a kite-flying tactic, it is easy to kill this Lizardmen army without loss.

However, now is not the time to play this tactic, what is needed now is time.

The Hydralisks deliberately slowed down the rhythm of the attack, allowing the Lizardmen's charge to unfold, shortening the attack distance, expanding the attack area, and improving the killing efficiency.

When the number of Lizardmen's army was reduced to a certain extent, the underground puppies rushed out, forming a terrifying sea of dogs in an instant, tearing the Lizardmen army apart!

Facing such a sea of dogs with an absolute numerical advantage, no enemy could hold on.

In this Lizardmen army, another one-star Lizardmen Knight was killed, and the Zerg killed 5/10 one-star creatures.

Kill or conquer 5 more one-star creatures, and the Zerg mother nest can be upgraded to one star, and all Zerg buildings will enter the one-star era.

At that time, the one-star Zerg can consume resources for production.

It is still difficult for the Zerg's combat units to upgrade their star levels by themselves.

Especially the puppies, it is easy to be damaged in battle, and if they do not participate in the battle, they cannot compete for the enemy's luck. It is basically impossible for them to upgrade.

The Hydralisks have not been damaged in battle. They are the most likely to upgrade their star levels by themselves. Some Hydralisks have participated in almost all battles, and the number of enemies they kill is very considerable.

As long as they seize enough of the enemy's luck, their strength will evolve and upgrade to one star.

Wu Qing sent a team of puppies to intercept the bugbear scouts who came to scout, and the Zerg army turned again and returned to the first battlefield.

The newly produced puppies were also on their way to the first battlefield.

There is still a time difference to fight. The third lizardman army is still very far away from the main reinforcement of the encirclement and suppression force. They have arrived at the first battlefield and are observing and waiting near the first battlefield.

The Zerg army arrived at the first battlefield. This time it is no longer an ambush and encounter, but an active offensive battle of the Zerg.

400 hydralisks went first. It is a bastard not to take advantage. The light infantry army of the lizardmen has no solution to the attack of the hydralisks and was completely restrained.

The lizardman army on standby finally found the enemy's traces and sent another signal flare to confirm the news.

The reinforcements of the bear goblin tribe who found the confirmation signal flare once again accelerated their marching speed.

"Hold the enemy!"

"The large army will arrive soon!"

"Victory belongs to the spirit god!"

The lizardman knight who led the last lizardman army shouted to encourage morale.

The attack of the hydralisk came whistling, and the morale of the enemy could not affect its efficiency in killing the enemy.

This lizardman army did not enter the open plains. They found that the long-range attack of the hydralisk was unstoppable, so they began to retreat to the mountains and forests relying on the terrain.

"Retreat to the mountains and forests! Hold on and wait for help!"

This trick is indeed effective, greatly reducing the effectiveness of the long-range attack of the hydralisk.

Wu Qing is calculating the arrival time of the reinforcements of the bugbear tribe. Now there is enough time, so let the hydralisks fight the lizardman army first.

Nearly 5,000 puppies have gathered near this lizardman army, waiting for Wu Qing's attack order.
